title: QuantumInputVector
description: 14-dimensional quantum input vector for VQC signal combiner. Asymmetrica Investments AG.

momentum_composite.description: PCA-reduced momentum score from RSI + MACD cross + BB ratio. Qubit 0.

momentum_acceleration.description: Rate of change of momentum composite. Qubit 1.

realized_vol_20d.description: 20-day realized volatility as percentile rank vs 252d history. Qubit 2.

atr_normalized.description: ATR as fraction of price, scaled to [0,1]. Qubit 4.

carry_differential.description: Interest rate differential (base - quote), standardized. Qubit 5.

yield_curve_slope.description: US 10Y - 2Y yield spread, scaled. 0.0 when unavailable. Qubit 6.

event_risk_score.description: Continuous event proximity risk: 1/(1+hours) x impact_weight. Qubit 7.

net_sentiment.description: Net sentiment differential: base currency vs quote currency. Qubit 8.

cot_positioning.description: COT net positioning differential (base - quote), normalized. Qubit 10.

cot_extreme.description: COT z-score vs 52-week history, divided by 3. Qubit 11.

risk_sentiment.description: VIX level as percentile rank vs 252d history. Qubit 13.
